definitions.explanation: The act of taking someone else's property without permission. Used as the noun form of the verb {盗|ぬす}む (to steal).

examples.japanese: {盗|ぬす}みは{犯罪|はんざい}だ。
{盗|ぬす}みを{働|はたら}いた{男|おとこ}が{捕|つか}まった。
examples.english: The man who committed the theft was caught.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}に{盗|ぬす}みをして、{親|おや}にひどく{叱|しか}られた。
examples.english: I stole something as a child and was severely scolded by my parents.

notes:
The noun form of {盗|ぬす}む (to steal). Refers to the act of stealing itself rather than the stolen goods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盗|ぬす}みを{働|はたら}く — to commit theft
- {盗|ぬす}みに{入|はい}る — to break in to steal
- {盗|ぬす}み{聞|ぎ}き — eavesdropping
- {盗|ぬす}み{見|み} — peeping, peeking
- {盗|ぬす}み{食|ぐ}い — sneaking food, eating on the sly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {窃盗|せっとう} — theft (legal/formal term used in criminal law)
- {万引|まんび}き — shoplifting (specifically from stores)
